templates.display_name: US trade facts, windowed to month grain
templates.description: Reads the DuckDB trade artifact (sample-trade-us): one row per flow/month/partner with the windowed HS-6 value sum. Expects STRING parameters named start_month and end_month in YYYY-MM form.
templates.body:
SELECT
    t.flow         AS flow,
    t.period       AS period,
    t.partner_code AS partner_code,
    t.partner_name AS partner_name,
    SUM(t.value_usd) AS value_usd
FROM trade_monthly t
WHERE t.period BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month
GROUP BY t.flow, t.period, t.partner_code, t.partner_name
ORDER BY t.partner_code, t.period, t.flow

templates.description: Runs in tempdb (H2) over stg_trade_monthly: exports, imports and net balance per partner across the staged window, with the largest-surplus and largest-deficit flags. Takes no parameters. Ratios are computed over DOUBLE casts (H2 DECIMAL division collapses scale — staging.md 11.3).
templates.body:
SELECT
    x.partner_name                                              AS partner_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN x.flow = 'exports' THEN x.value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS exports_usd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN x.flow = 'imports' THEN x.value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS imports_usd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN x.flow = 'exports' THEN x.value_usd ELSE -x.value_usd END) AS net_balance_usd,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN x.flow = 'imports' THEN x.value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) /
          NULLIF(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN x.flow = 'exports' THEN x.value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE), 0), 3) AS import_export_ratio
FROM stg_trade_monthly x
GROUP BY x.partner_name
ORDER BY CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN x.flow = 'exports' THEN x.value_usd ELSE -x.value_usd END) AS DOUBLE) DESC

templates.display_name: Partner-reported trade with the USA (Comtrade mirror)
templates.description: Reads the MySQL world-trade artifact (sample-trade-world): what each reporter country says it exported to / imported from the USA, annual TOTAL level, plus the reporter name lookup. Takes no parameters (the table is small; window filtering belongs to the caller).
templates.body:
SELECT
    c.reporter_code AS reporter_code,
    r.reporter_name AS reporter_name,
    c.flow          AS flow,
    c.period        AS period,
    c.value_usd     AS value_usd
FROM comtrade_annual c
JOIN reporters r ON r.reporter_code = c.reporter_code
ORDER BY c.reporter_code, c.period, c.flow

templates.description: Runs in tempdb (H2): joins stg_us_reported (DuckDB, US-reported annual trade per partner) to stg_partner_reported (MySQL, partner-reported) on the ISO code and computes the reporting gap. X = what the partner says it exported to the USA, mirrored against US imports; M = what the partner says it imported from the USA, against US exports. Gap percentage is computed over DOUBLE casts (H2 DECIMAL division collapses scale — staging.md 11.3). Takes no parameters.
templates.body:
SELECT
    x.partner_name                                                     AS partner_name,
    x.period                                                          AS period,
    x.us_imports_from_partner                                         AS us_imports_from_partner,
    x.partner_exports_to_us                                           AS partner_exports_to_us,
    x.us_exports_to_partner                                           AS us_exports_to_partner,
    x.partner_imports_from_us                                         AS partner_imports_from_us,
    ROUND(CAST(x.partner_exports_to_us AS DOUBLE) /
          NULLIF(CAST(x.us_imports_from_partner AS DOUBLE), 0) * 100, 1) AS mirror_import_ratio_pct,
    ROUND(CAST(x.partner_imports_from_us AS DOUBLE) /
          NULLIF(CAST(x.us_exports_to_partner AS DOUBLE), 0) * 100, 1) AS mirror_export_ratio_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        iso.partner_name                       AS partner_name,
        substr(u.period, 1, 4)               AS period,
        SUM(CASE WHEN u.flow = 'imports' THEN u.value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS us_imports_from_partner,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.flow = 'X' THEN m.value_usd END)               AS partner_exports_to_us,
        SUM(CASE WHEN u.flow = 'exports' THEN u.value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS us_exports_to_partner,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.flow = 'M' THEN m.value_usd END)             AS partner_imports_from_us
    FROM stg_us_reported u
    JOIN stg_iso iso ON iso.census_code = u.partner_code
    JOIN stg_partner_reported m ON m.reporter_code = iso.iso_numeric
        AND m.period = substr(u.period, 1, 4)
    GROUP BY iso.partner_name, substr(u.period, 1, 4), u.partner_code
) x
ORDER BY x.partner_name, x.period

templates.description: Reads the DuckDB trade artifact (sample-trade-us): the partner_iso_crosswalk table mapping Census partner codes to UN M49 numeric codes (with names), for joining US-reported facts to Comtrade mirror statistics. Takes no parameters.
templates.body:
SELECT
    x.census_code  AS census_code,
    x.iso_numeric  AS iso_numeric,
    x.partner_name AS partner_name
FROM partner_iso_crosswalk x
ORDER BY x.census_code

templates.description: Reads the SQLite FX artifact (sample-fx): the Federal Reserve monthly average rate for each reconciled partner's currency, keyed by the Census partner code so the trade facts join to it without a CASE. The month is emitted as `period` — the grain name the rest of this family uses, and the one spelling H2 accepts unquoted downstream (MONTH is a keyword there). per_usd is always foreign-currency-per-USD, usd_per always its inverse. Expects STRING parameters start_month and end_month in YYYY-MM form and partner (an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or ALL).
templates.body:
SELECT
    f.month        AS period,
    p.census_code  AS census_code,
    p.partner      AS partner,
    p.partner_name AS partner_name,
    f.currency     AS currency,
    f.per_usd      AS per_usd,
    f.usd_per      AS usd_per
FROM fx_monthly f
JOIN partner_currency p ON p.currency = f.currency
WHERE f.month BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month
  AND (:partner = 'ALL' OR p.partner = :partner)
ORDER BY p.partner, f.month

templates.display_name: US imports in the partner's own currency (tempdb)
templates.description: Runs in tempdb (H2) over stg_trade_monthly (DuckDB, US Census) and stg_fx_monthly (SQLite, Federal Reserve): monthly US import value restated in the partner's currency, the month-over-month move in the rate, and the USD-strength effect — what the same month's imports would have cost in partner currency at the PRIOR month's rate, minus what they cost at this one. Both are NULL in a window's first month, which has no prior rate. Takes no parameters. Every ratio operand is cast to DOUBLE (H2 DECIMAL division collapses scale — staging.md 11.3).
templates.body:
WITH staged AS (
    SELECT
        f.partner                        AS partner,
        f.partner_name                   AS partner_name,
        f.currency                       AS currency,
        f.period                         AS period,
        CAST(f.per_usd AS DOUBLE)        AS per_usd,
        CAST(SUM(t.value_usd) AS DOUBLE) AS imports_usd
    FROM stg_fx_monthly f
    JOIN stg_trade_monthly t
      ON t.partner_code = f.census_code
     AND t.period       = f.period
     AND t.flow         = 'imports'
    GROUP BY f.partner, f.partner_name, f.currency, f.period, f.per_usd
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT
        partner, partner_name, currency, period, per_usd, imports_usd,
        LAG(per_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY partner ORDER BY period) AS prev_per_usd
    FROM staged
)
SELECT
    partner                                                 AS partner,
    partner_name                                            AS partner_name,
    currency                                                AS currency,
    period                                                  AS period,
    ROUND(imports_usd, 2)                                   AS imports_usd,
    per_usd                                                 AS rate_per_usd,
    ROUND(imports_usd * per_usd, 2)                         AS imports_in_currency,
    ROUND((per_usd / NULLIF(prev_per_usd, 0) - 1) * 100, 3) AS rate_mom_pct,
    ROUND(imports_usd * (prev_per_usd - per_usd), 2)        AS usd_strength_effect
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY partner, period

templates.description: Reads the DuckDB trade artifact (sample-trade-us): Herfindahl-Hirschman concentration of a partner's imports across HS chapters, per year — how diversified that sourcing is. Expects STRING parameters named start_year and end_year in YYYY form.
templates.body:
WITH chapter_year AS (
    SELECT
        t.partner_name                                  AS partner_name,
        substr(t.period, 1, 4)                         AS yr,
        c.chapter                                       AS chapter,
        SUM(t.value_usd)                                AS chapter_value
    FROM trade_monthly t
    JOIN hs_chapters c ON c.chapter = substr(t.hs_code, 1, 2)
    WHERE t.flow = 'imports'
      AND substr(t.period, 1, 4) BETWEEN :start_year AND :end_year
    GROUP BY t.partner_name, substr(t.period, 1, 4), c.chapter
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        partner_name, yr,
        chapter_value,
        chapter_value / NULLIF(SUM(chapter_value) OVER (PARTITION BY partner_name, yr), 0) AS share
    FROM chapter_year
)
SELECT
    partner_name                          AS partner_name,
    yr                                    AS yr,
    COUNT(*)                              AS chapters_sourced,
    ROUND(SUM(share * share) * 10000, 1)  AS hhi
FROM shares
GROUP BY partner_name, yr
ORDER BY hhi DESC

pipelines.name: trade_reconciliation
pipelines.description: Whose numbers are bigger? Joins what the US says it traded with each partner (DuckDB, Census) against what that partner reports trading with the US (MySQL, UN Comtrade) — the classic mirror-statistics gap, in percent. Three engines: DuckDB facts, MySQL mirror, H2 join. Only the five Comtrade reporters reconcile.

end_month.description: Inclusive end month, YYYY-MM. The sample covers 2023-01 to 2024-12.

pipelines.name: imports_in_partner_currency
pipelines.display_name: US imports in the partner's own currency
pipelines.description: What did the US actually buy, in the seller's money? Restates monthly US import value (DuckDB, US Census) in each partner's currency at the Federal Reserve's monthly average rate (SQLite, H.10/G.5), and separates the trade move from the currency move: the month-over-month rate change, and the USD-strength effect — the partner-currency difference between valuing this month's imports at last month's rate and at this one's. Three engines: DuckDB facts, SQLite rates, H2 join.

start_month.description: Inclusive start month, YYYY-MM. The sample covers 2023-01 to 2024-12.

end_month.description: Inclusive end month, YYYY-MM. The sample covers 2023-01 to 2024-12.

partner.description: Which partner to restate: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code — CN, CA, MX, JP or DE — or ALL (the default) for all five.
